measurementRoot: Pass the extracted directory containing provenance.json; expected upload prefix r4307p. Do not infer it from whole-PR paths.
outputPolicy: A distinct directory and run-specific filenames. Existing outputs cause refusal. If a reviewed QA correction becomes necessary, preserve the initial output and source version and use a new directory.

validationOverlay.location: control-validation.json contains original/generated SHA, omitted assertion, commands/status/cleanup/source-clean results; there is no separate overlay-provenance.json.
validationOverlay.omission: Only immutable-content assertion in a temporary sibling test; original remains unchanged and all other assertions run.

analysis: Strict pinned source/hardware/harness and direct-child one-file control verification.
Exact aggregate/leaf equality, all observations/outliers retained, recompute nearest-rank quantiles.
Per-process arithmetic medians as well as nearest-rank p50; four-sample nearest-rank p50 alone can hide two slow values.
All recorded build/raster/total frame arrays, counts, maxima and process distributions.
Verify steady-scroll no content I/O and distinguish phase FrameTiming from trace-derived pipeline availability.
Preserve missing timeline evidence and missing final status/diff as distinct evidence limitations.
Retain all 672 required measured observations; observer-timing-qa.json applies to the identical harness.
Interpret all 21 actions, including warmup frames separately from readiness latency and unavailable layout/paint.
sourceCaveats: Representation control retains all unrelated candidate behavior.
Flat content mutability and identity of internal/state flag snapshots are representation-mediated differences.
Readiness scan/observer costs can depend on representation; do not subtract estimated overhead.

decisionCriteria.ready: Assess whether the actual results resolve the documented interaction/frame concerns and existing experiment hold. Ready is not merge approval.
decisionCriteria.retainDraft: Concrete unresolved or inconclusive interaction/frame evidence, unavailable required platform validation, or explicit existing experimental hold can remain reasons.
decisionCriteria.close: Consider only after valid isolated evidence establishes an unfavorable tradeoff; preserve independent correctness fixes. A single outlier, CI infrastructure failure or unavailable GPU does not by itself justify closure.
decisionCriteria.physicalGpu: This hosted run is not presumed to meet physical-GPU requirements; verify actual manifest hardware.
decisionCriteria.runSeparation: Never pool observations or ratios across whole-PR and isolated runs/hardware.
